aboutText: Based in Craigieburn, Top Notch Designz is a carpentry workshop specialising in custom props, arches, and event decorations. We bring creativity and quality to every project, ensuring designs that make celebrations unique. servicesText: At Top Notch Designz in Craigieburn, we offer comprehensive carpentry services from consultation to execution. Our expertise includes crafting custom arches, event props, and decorative pieces, all made with high-quality materials and exceptional craftsmanship.
